reference_answer: The team resolved to revise the procedure. In addition, the thesis begins with a review of the literature on urban transport. By enforcing these explicit conditions, the model maintains stable performance across evaluation horizons without relying on ad hoc heuristics.
acceptable_alternatives: In our experimental protocol, the team resolved to revise the procedure. Meanwhile, the thesis begins with a review of the literature on urban transport.
explanation_zh:
【高分技术微写作解析】
1. 词汇与熟词生义精准落地：自然融入了“resolve to”（搭配：resolve to revise a procedure）与“review of the literature on”（搭配：a review of the literature on education）；
2. 句子成分与尾重控制：每句均采用“简短主语（3–5 词）+ 强及物/系动词 + 后置宾语与条件状语”结构，毫无头重脚轻感；
3. 零 AI 痕迹：直接交代操作、约束与评估范围，文风贴近 NeurIPS/ICLR 顶会标准。注意：参考答案并非唯一正确表达。
